Bill.BriefDescription: Designating certain hydroelectric generation from a generation facility located in irrigation pipes, irrigation canals, and wastewater pipes as an eligible renewable resource under chapter 19.285 RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating certain hydroelectric generationfrom a generation facility located in irrigation pipes, irrigationcanals, and wastewater pipes as an eligible renewable resource underchapter 19.285 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 87.03 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 87.03 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The generation of electricity by an irrigation district as providedin RCW 87.03.015, from water power made available by and as a part ofirrigation district water conveyance and distribution facilities, wasteways, and drainage water facilities shall be considered an eligiblerenewable resource that qualifies for renewable energy credit asprovided in chapter 19.285 RCW.
